'Target SWORD OR DAGGER attack gains +1{p} and piercing 1.'

ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN is an OR over the list, which is what 'sword or dagger' means; two separate conditions would be an AND and the reaction could never be played.

Piercing is in the card DB `keywords` because the printed text names it, but it is GRANTED TO THE TARGET here rather than carried by this card -- Puncture is a reaction and never attacks, so the printed keyword is inert on it and the grant is the whole clause.
